name: Hello, Orbit
description: When the waters rise, perspective saves lives. Build a satellite that can map floods and get the data home.
objective: Monitor flooding from low Earth orbit.

name: Lunar Ice Hunter
description: There is water hidden in the shadows. Send a polar orbiter to find the ice that could fuel our next giant leap.
objective: Find water ice at the lunar poles.

name: Against the Odds
description: A damaged solar array. A very long way from home. Design with enough margin to bring your mission back from the brink.
objective: Survive a major solar-array failure and return science.

name: Open Cosmos
description: No budget ceiling. No wrong questions. Follow your curiosity and discover how one small change can reshape a mission.
objective: Experiment freely. Physical limits still apply.
